decision.reason: [ev-fa371709f05a] is a one-line release note. It says only that writing a kubeconfig to the CNI net directory was removed, so the change type (removed) is clear. It does not name the component or setting involved, or say where the kubeconfig goes now, if anywhere. It also does not say which environments or consumers relied on that file, or what happens to them after upgrading. Without the PR behind note 52323 or similar detail, nobody can write the applicability or consequence aspects.
